review.reason: The P1.F2.H1 hunk demonstrates a bounded correctness improvement: it adds row-count matching before positioning labels in visual review tooltips. This could help users interpret warehouse-change diffs more accurately when multiple bands exist or counts mismatch. The remaining hunks are either dependent metadata (dependency bump) or test support, so they do not independently raise the tier. No tier-3 systemic risk reduction or adoption proof is demonstrated.
